title: 第一百七十章 新上帝之鞭第一百六十九章 克拉科夫合战
content_zh:
不莱梅是德意志地区最古老的城市之一，也是德意志北海沿岸最大的港口。
同时，不莱梅也是德意志地区最早的大主教区之一。
两百多年前，不莱梅建城，一百五十年前，不莱梅升大主教区，成为德意志地区实际上由教会直接控制的繁荣地区。
德意志许多后来晋升的大主教区，实际上大主教是由德意志皇帝任命，其是大主教区的主教，同时也是当地的封建领主。
但不莱梅就不是如此了，其大主教通常是由罗马教廷直接任命。
不莱梅地区大多数土地都归教会所有，不莱梅大主教格布哈德用宗教法和世俗法统治着不莱梅城及整个教区辽阔土地。
不莱梅在威悉河河畔，直对北海出海口，是基督教向北欧传播的据点，由此，商贸也极为发达。
初春之际，齐人武装商船的船队抵达不莱梅时，刚刚由南方传来的噩耗，因为帝国军队在克拉科夫大败，本就病中的帝国皇帝奥托三世惊怒之下离世，这也使得本就对议和款项意见不一的宫廷重臣及势力强大的几大公国公爵立时爆发了更尖锐的冲突。
因为奥托三世没有子嗣，甚至可以说，萨克森公爵家族直系都已经绝裔，帝国皇帝的头衔将会花落谁家自然成了最大的悬念，相比之下，和齐人议和的条款，一时都没有人理会了，只可怜了在克拉科夫和齐人谈判的使团，只能暂时拖一天算一天。
在这种情势下，不莱梅突然到访的齐人船队，就不免显得意味深长了。
而且，其在北海的恶名，早就传到了不莱梅。
这支船队，说是“商船”船队，实际却是一支强大的海上力量，斯堪的纳维亚人武装商船就有四十几艘，听说是这支商队向斯堪的纳维亚人购买的，而且，随船雇佣的斯堪的纳维亚人水手、武装船员等等有千余人，齐人称为“瑞典水营”，更莫说，其好像还有真正来自东方的一支火器步兵营，他们都是典型的东方面孔，在不莱梅城引起了巨大恐慌。
东方军团在克拉科夫展现的毁灭性力量，使得一些可怕的传说已经瘟疫般散播四方。
甚至有传说，东方人都是会操纵各种可怕魔法的巫师，他们手中的神罚之器，轻轻敲击下便可以召唤吐火的恶龙，一起和东方人为敌的异教徒，都会在恶龙的火焰中被焚烧干净。
不莱梅大主教格布哈德当然不相信这些乡下人才会相信的谣言，但他更知道，这个东方帝国仅仅黑海殖民点展现的力量可以看得出，这个帝国是多么的强盛和可怕，实际上，这可能比东方人各个是巫师的谣言，更令人恐惧。
因为巫师，可能还会有上帝来打理，但一个文明程度高度发达到完全可以将基督教区看作野蛮之地的强大文明的到来，如果带来的是善意，那也会使得西方的信仰和传统都开始崩塌；如果带来的是恶意，那么，被摧毁的，将会是一切。
几百年前匈人的所谓上帝之鞭，和现今基督世界的危机比，简直不值一提。
而且，不莱梅不知道是幸运还是不幸，成为了北海中，东方战舰第一个拜访的目的地。
真正来自东方的战舰，就这样现身了，而听说，这还是齐人战舰中的次一级主力舰，专门为近海作战打造的战舰。
但仅仅一艘这样的东方旗舰，可能已经永远改变了北海海上力量的对比，在齐人船队从波罗的海进入北海而从丹麦国土海峡中穿行时，本来要阻拦的丹麦人已经受到了教训，付出的代价，极为惨烈。

前去拦截齐人船队的丹麦人舰队，有几艘战舰，当场被齐人的舰队发射的巨大铁球击沉或者被漫天的火箭射中付之一炬，更莫说，只要进入自己舒适射程的丹麦战船，几乎每个船长都立时会被齐人的弓弩贯穿头颅，这也使得北欧人更深信齐人能发射巫师诅咒的箭矢的传说。
甚至，这个齐人商队大获全胜后，还驶入停泊在了丹麦人首都罗斯基勒港，当丹麦人组织人手想登船时，但这些维京海盗后裔却遭遇了更严重的惨败。
不管是身材高大根本不是人类的齐人的巨灵军团，还是威力惊人的火器和弓弩，都是悍不畏死的维京海盗们从来未经历过的战争，甚至齐人根本没有什么伤亡，就将维京战士击败，看起来，他们便是想攻陷罗斯基勒也不会有太多阻碍。
不过，这个高度发达的东方文明好像对侵占土地确实没什么兴趣，其首先宣布这是一场误会。
丹麦人随之很快和这支商队签订了谅解备忘录，送上了大量物资和赔款。
悬挂大齐旗帜的所有船只，都可以在丹麦海域通行无阻。
且谅解备忘录里，还承诺每个来到罗斯基勒港进行贸易的齐商，都会得到税率极低的特许权。
还有个传闻，据说丹麦人献出了许多美女来贿赂齐人商队一位重要人物，由此才终于和齐人达成和平，是真是假，就不知道了。
齐人船队在罗斯基勒港停泊了月余时间，北海沿岸所有港口都在惊恐的议论着他们，不知道他们进入北海后，目的地到底是哪里。
不莱梅大主教格布哈德隐隐有预感，感觉齐人“商队”不会错过来不莱梅的机会，因为从波罗的海进入北海后，不莱梅正是北海南岸大陆的第一站。
维京人曾经的发源地，丹麦人在这支武装船队面前碰得头破血流，南部的斯堪的纳维亚人，齐人称为的“瑞典人”，看起来，更已经被齐人的强大慑服，被齐人的金钱收买，被齐人宣扬的荣誉打动，已经成了齐人的忠实仆从和帮凶。
不过，经历了南方帝国和波兰联军惨败的消息洗礼，经历了那些无限渲染齐人是如何恐怖和强大流言灌输，所以，北方海域发生的这一切，好像又没有令人太过震惊。
不莱梅大主教格布哈德，深思熟虑后，很热情的欢迎了齐人商队的到来，并极快签发了允许齐人商船在此停泊、允许齐人商船船员在城内居留、以及允许齐人商队在此贸易等等权力的特许状。
content_en:
Bremen is one of the oldest cities in Germany and the largest port on the German North Sea coast.
At the same time, Bremen is also one of the earliest archdioceses in Germany.
More than two hundred years ago, Bremen was founded as a city. One hundred and fifty years ago, Bremen was promoted to the Archdiocese and became a prosperous area in Germany that was actually directly controlled by the church.
In many archdioceses in Germany that were later promoted, the archbishop was actually appointed by the German emperor, who was the bishop of the archdiocese and also the local feudal lord.
This is not the case in Bremen, whose archbishop is usually appointed directly by the Holy See.
Most of the land in the Bremen area is owned by the church. Archbishop Gebhard of Bremen rules the city of Bremen and the vast land of the entire diocese with religious and secular laws.
Bremen is located on the banks of the Weser River, directly facing the outlet of the North Sea. It is a stronghold for the spread of Christianity to Northern Europe. As a result, commerce and trade are also extremely developed.
In early spring, when the Qi people's armed merchant fleet arrived in Bremen, the bad news just came from the south. Because the imperial army was defeated in Krakow, the already ill Emperor Otto III passed away in shock and anger. This also caused the palace ministers and the powerful dukes of several principalities who had different opinions on the peace settlement to immediately erupt into more sharp conflicts.
Because Otto III had no heirs, and it could even be said that the direct line of the Duke of Saxony was extinct, the biggest suspense was naturally to which family the title of imperial emperor would go to. In contrast, no one paid attention to the terms of the peace negotiations with the Qi people. It was only pitiful that the envoys negotiating with the Qi people in Krakow could only delay for a day.
Under this situation, the sudden visit of Bremen's fleet of people cannot help but seem meaningful.
Moreover, its notoriety in the North Sea has long spread to Bremen.
This fleet, said to be a "merchant fleet", is actually a powerful maritime force. There are more than forty armed Scandinavian merchant ships. I heard that this merchant fleet purchased them from the Scandinavians. Moreover, more than a thousand Scandinavian sailors, armed crew members, etc. were hired on the ships. The Qi people called them the "Swedish Water Camp". Not to mention, there seemed to be a firearms infantry battalion from the East. They were all typical oriental faces, causing great panic in the city of Bremen.
The destructive power displayed by the Eastern Legion in Krakow caused some terrible legends to spread like a plague.
There are even legends that the Orientals are wizards who can manipulate all kinds of terrible magic. The weapon of divine punishment in their hands can summon a fire-breathing dragon with a gentle tap. The pagans who are enemies of the Orientals will be burned cleanly in the dragon's flames.
Archbishop Gebhard of Bremen certainly didn't believe these rumors that country people would believe, but he knew better that the power displayed by this Eastern Empire's Black Sea settlement alone showed how powerful and terrifying this Empire was. In fact, this might be more frightening than the rumors that the Easterners were all wizards.
Because of wizards, God may still take care of it, but the arrival of a powerful civilization that is so highly developed that it can completely treat the Christian area as a barbaric land. If it brings goodwill, it will also cause Western beliefs and traditions to begin to collapse; if it brings malice, then everything will be destroyed.
The so-called whip of God of the Huns hundreds of years ago is nothing compared to the crisis in Christendom today.
Moreover, whether it was luck or misfortune, Bremen became the first destination visited by Eastern warships in the North Sea.
The warship that truly comes from the East has just appeared, and I heard that this is a second-tier battleship among the Qi people's warships, a warship specially built for offshore combat.
But just one such Eastern flagship may have forever changed the balance of maritime power in the North Sea.When the Luo Sea entered the North Sea and passed through the Danish strait, the Danes who were supposed to block it had already learned a lesson, and the price they paid was extremely tragic.
Several warships of the Danish fleet that went to intercept the Qi people's fleet were sunk by huge iron balls launched by the Qi people's fleet or were shot and burned by rockets in the sky. Not to mention, as soon as a Danish warship entered their comfortable shooting range, almost every captain would be immediately pierced through the head by the Qi people's crossbows. This also made the Nordic people believe even more in the legend that the Qi people can shoot arrows cursed by wizards.
Even after the Qi people's caravan won a great victory, it sailed into the port of Roskilde, the Danish capital. When the Danes organized people to board the ship, these descendants of the Viking pirates suffered a more serious defeat.
Whether it was the Qi people's djinn army who were tall and not human at all, or the astonishingly powerful firearms and crossbows, it was a war that the Viking pirates, who were not afraid of death, had never experienced. Even the Qi people defeated the Viking warriors without any casualties. It seemed that they would not have too many obstacles even if they wanted to capture Roskilde.
However, this highly developed Eastern civilization does not seem to be interested in occupying land. It first announced that this was a misunderstanding.
The Danes quickly signed a memorandum of understanding with the caravan and sent a large amount of supplies and compensation.
All ships flying the Daqi flag can pass through Danish waters without obstruction.
Moreover, in the memorandum of understanding, it is also promised that every merchant who comes to Roskilde Port for trade will receive a concession with extremely low tax rate.
There is also a rumor that the Danes offered many beautiful women to bribe an important figure in the Qi people's caravan, and finally reached peace with the Qi people. I don't know whether it is true or not.
The fleet of Qi people was anchored in Roskilde Port for more than a month. All the ports along the North Sea coast were talking about them in horror, wondering where their destination would be after entering the North Sea.
Archbishop Gebhard of Bremen had a vague premonition that the Qi people's "caravan" would not miss the opportunity to come to Bremen, because after entering the North Sea from the Baltic Sea, Bremen was the first stop on the mainland on the south coast of the North Sea.
In the former birthplace of the Vikings, the Danes suffered a bloody blow in front of this armed fleet. The Scandinavians in the south, whom the Qi people called "Swedes", seemed to have been overawed by the Qi people's power, bribed by the Qi people's money, and moved by the honor promoted by the Qi people. They had become loyal servants and accomplices of the Qi people.
However, after experiencing the news of the disastrous defeat of the Southern Empire and the Polish Allied Forces, and the endless rumors that exaggerated how terrifying and powerful the Qi people were, everything that happened in the northern seas did not seem to be too shocking.
Archbishop Gebhard of Bremen, after careful consideration, warmly welcomed the arrival of the Qi people's caravan, and quickly issued a charter allowing the Qi people's merchant ships to berth here, allowing the Qi people's merchant ship crews to reside in the city, and allowing the Qi people's merchant ships to trade here, etc.
